data.title: 五更琉璃 · 客厅榻榻米的同人Galgame测试
data.description: 五更家温馨的榻榻米客厅上，并肩坐在笔记本电脑前测试自制恋爱游戏。屏幕上跳出心动告白CG的瞬间，黑猫整张脸通红，假装咳嗽却偷偷偏头打量你的侧颜。

data.promptProse: Ruri sits at the laptop in her black dress and red rose hair ornaments, her long black hair falling across her flushed cheek. Her playtester sits beside her in a gray zip jacket, short brown hair and rectangular glasses catching the screen light. She steals a look at his profile just as the confession appears on the screen.
